defect: R4 reached the install step but unauthenticated Git smart-HTTP was rate-limited by GitHub with HTTP 429 before Hermes could install.
fix: Replace unauthenticated git fetch with authenticated GitHub REST tarball retrieval for the exact pinned Hermes commit.
Keep GitHub token scoped to the install step only; it is not forwarded to the Airlock worker.
Retain source commit and archive SHA-256 in the diagnostic artifact.
Leave R4 worker-evidence retention and all frozen HERMES-LIVE acceptance files unchanged.
